label: A possible contingent-free past from possible founded coming-to-be (inference)
rule: Descend along the founded past to a moment with nothing earlier; coming to be excludes contingent occupants there
meaning: New non-transcription conditional support option for premise A3 of the modal spine to God's existence. In the accessible history, the contingent individual x present at the founded moment t was absent at an earlier moment s. Because there is no endless descent below t, some moment m at or below s has no strictly earlier moment (classical case split along accessibility of the strict order). Any contingent concrete individual present at m would need a still earlier moment of absence, which m lacks; so m is free of contingent concrete individuals and lies strictly before t, where x is present. No frame condition, presence contract, inertness of emptiness or causal relation is used. The single premise is OPEN; it is a possibility claim and is stronger than the conclusion. This repairs, for contingent concrete things under an earlier-absence reading and a founded past, the quantifier shift the corpus records as invalid in general; nothing is attributed to a source. No premise truth is established.
